guidance: And sir, if you can give some kind of guidance as to what capacity utilization or revenue you are looking for in FY2027 and margins we can expect.
80% is a good target for capacity utilization.
capex: Sir, capacity expansion, when I look at the presentation we had, we are planning to go from 18 lakh pieces to 38 lakh pieces.
And the current capacity is 65% and has a good room for growth for the next one or two years, if I am not wrong.
risks: So, sir, if we look at the performance of this company in FY26, I know we had tariffs even in Q1, we have some headwinds.
We took this step primarily for the US market given the uncertainty on geopolitical situation.
focus: Global brands are actively diversifying their sourcing base under the China Plus One strategy.
We remain focused on building an institution that will continue to earn the trust of our customers, employees, and shareholders for generations to come.
So, we consciously maintained our focus on premium bottom ware segment.
